name: cc-nexs
description: Lean 默认的低 Token 开发流水线：计划门禁、本地验证、一次集中 Review、test 验收与发布门禁；保留 fast/full。

interface.shortDescription: Run cc-nexs SOP workflows in Codex
interface.longDescription: cc-nexs defaults to a low-token Lean workflow with two human gates, per-repository worktrees, deterministic local verification, one consolidated Review, test verification, configurable per-role models, and approved base integration. Legacy full, fast, and hotfix workflows remain available.
